highlight.zh: 中文 · 马来文 双语版本

summary.zh: 为 Kingsman Solutions 制作 6 支竖版短视频与 12 张社媒广告设计，内容涵盖个人贷款、政府贷款方案、先买后付与招聘，并同步产出中文与马来文双语版本。
summary.en: Six vertical short-form videos and twelve social ad designs for Kingsman Solutions, covering personal loans, government loan schemes, buy-now-pay-later and recruitment — delivered in both Chinese and Malay.

challenge.zh: 个人贷款是竞争激烈、信任门槛又高的品类。受众多半是被银行拒绝之后才开始找替代方案，情绪敏感，对广告本能怀疑。同时客群横跨华裔与巫裔，一套内容说不动两边——讲得太硬像推销，讲得太软又建立不了专业感。
challenge.en: Personal lending is crowded and trust-sensitive at once. People usually start looking for alternatives only after a bank has turned them down, so they arrive wary and quick to dismiss an ad. The audience also spans Chinese- and Malay-speaking Malaysians, and one cut cannot carry both — too hard a sell reads as pushy, too soft and the expertise never lands.

approach.zh: 同一支影片分别剪出中文与马来文版本，覆盖华裔与巫裔两个受众群。设计端按主题分组产出：贷款广告、政府贷款、好评见证、Spay Later 与招聘贴文，方便按投放档期轮替素材。
approach.en: Each video was cut into separate Chinese and Malay versions to reach both audience segments. Designs were produced in themed sets — loan ads, government loan, customer reviews, Spay Later and hiring posts — so creatives could be rotated across ad flights.

zh: 6 支竖版短视频（中文 / 马来文双版本）
12 张社媒广告设计
主题分组：贷款 / 政府贷款 / 好评 / 招聘
en: Themed sets: loans / government loan / reviews / hiring

highlight.zh: 婚礼 · 企业 · 囍屏 三条产品线

summary.zh: 为 YSE Production 制作 6 支短视频与 13 张社媒设计，内容分为婚礼现场、企业活动与囍屏三条产品线，完整呈现活动制作的现场效果。
summary.en: Six short videos and thirteen social designs for YSE Production, split across three product lines — wedding events, corporate events and LED “Xi” screens — showcasing live production quality.

challenge.zh: 婚礼与活动制作最难的是「说服还没看过现场的人」。灯光、舞台、囍屏的效果照片拍不出来，而客户往往是一生一次的决定，比价之外更在意「会不会出错」。三条产品线（婚礼／企业／囍屏）受众也不同，混在一起讲会失焦。
challenge.en: Event production is hard to sell to anyone who has not stood in the room. Lighting, staging and an LED Xi screen do not survive a still photo, and for most couples this is a once-in-a-lifetime booking — the fear is not price, it is something going wrong on the day. Three product lines also speak to three different audiences, and blurring them loses all of them.

approach.zh: 影片以婚礼现场实拍为主，突出灯光、舞台与囍屏的视觉效果；设计端做成婚礼与活动两套系列贴文，可依接单档期分别投放。
approach.en: Videos lead with live wedding footage, highlighting lighting, staging and the LED Xi screen; designs were built as two post series — weddings and corporate events — so each can run in its own booking season.

zh: 6 支短视频（婚礼 / 企业 / 囍屏）
13 张社媒设计
婚礼与活动两套贴文系列
en: Two post series: weddings and events

highlight.zh: 零售 · 经销商 双客群

summary.zh: 为 3G Three Generations Mobile 制作 6 支门店短视频与 8 张维修主题设计，分别针对 Kepong 门市零售与经销商两种客群，并产出中文与马来文双语设计。
summary.en: Six in-store short videos and eight repair-themed designs for 3G Three Generations Mobile, targeting both Kepong walk-in retail and dealer audiences, with designs delivered in Chinese and Malay.

challenge.zh: 手机零售与维修的客群其实是两种生意：走进门市的散客，和批量拿货的经销商。两者的顾虑完全不同——散客怕被坑，经销商看的是货源稳不稳、价格有没有空间。用同一套内容打两边，通常两边都不到位。加上客群跨语言，中文和马来文都要覆盖。
challenge.en: Phone retail and repair is really two businesses wearing one shopfront: walk-in customers and trade dealers. Their worries barely overlap — a walk-in is afraid of being overcharged, a dealer is weighing supply reliability and margin. One set of content aimed at both usually reaches neither. The customer base is also split across languages, so Chinese and Malay both have to be covered.

approach.zh: 影片按客群拆成「零售」与「经销商」两条线，同一门店场景拍出不同话术；维修主题设计做成中文四张、马来文四张的对照组，方便同时投放两个语言市场。
approach.en: Videos were split into retail and dealer tracks — same store setting, different messaging. Repair designs were produced as a matched set of four Chinese and four Malay, so both language markets could run in parallel.

zh: 6 支门店短视频（零售 / 经销商）
8 张维修主题设计（中文 4 + 马来文 4）

highlight.zh: 痛点式开场，3 秒锁定受众
highlight.en: Pain-point hook in the first 3 seconds

summary.zh: 为 Ace Consistent 制作 4 支短视频与 11 张社媒广告设计，影片以「银行拒贷」的真实痛点切入，用问题式开场吸引正在申请贷款的受众。
summary.en: Four short videos and eleven social ad designs for Ace Consistent. The videos open on a real pain point — loan rejection by banks — using a question-led hook aimed at people mid-application.

challenge.zh: 贷款咨询最大的敌人不是竞争对手，是「已经被拒绝几次、不想再试」的心理。这群人滑到广告的第一反应是跳过。内容如果从公司简介或服务清单讲起，三秒内就被划走——必须先说中他们心里那句「为什么银行不告诉我原因」。
challenge.en: The real obstacle in loan consultancy is not a competitor, it is someone who has already been rejected twice and has stopped trying. Their first instinct on seeing an ad is to scroll. Content that opens with a company introduction or a service list is gone within three seconds — it has to name the question already in their head: why did the bank never say why.

approach.zh: 影片开场直接抛出受众心里的问题（「银行拒绝你，却不会告诉你原因」「不要一直申请，一直被拒」），前 3 秒就锁定目标客群；设计端做成 V2 / V3 两套版本，方便 A/B 测试不同视觉。
approach.en: Each video opens with the question already in the viewer’s head — “the bank rejected you and never told you why” — locking in the target audience within the first three seconds. Designs were produced as two versions (V2 / V3) to A/B test visuals.

zh: 4 支短视频（痛点式开场）
11 张社媒广告设计（V2 / V3 两套版本）
en: 11 social ad designs across two versions (V2 / V3)

client_name: 林老师火锅 Lin Lao Shi Hotpot

highlight.zh: 主打 RM50 火锅 Buffet 促销
highlight.en: Built around the RM50 buffet promo

summary.zh: 为林老师火锅制作 4 支餐饮短视频，主打 RM50 火锅 Buffet 促销、午餐免费续面与 PJ 分店，用食物特写与现场氛围带出「吃到饱」的价值感。
summary.en: Four F&B short videos for Lin Lao Shi Hotpot, built around the RM50 all-you-can-eat promotion, free lunch noodle refills and the PJ outlet — using food close-ups and dining-room atmosphere to sell the value.

challenge.zh: 餐饮促销的难处在于「便宜」和「划算」是两件事。RM50 吃到饱如果只把价格喊出来，容易被理解成品质妥协；要让人愿意开车过来，得先看到锅里实际有什么、店里是什么氛围。加上 Serdang 与 PJ 两间分店，内容还要顾到不同商圈的客人。
challenge.en: In F&B promotion, cheap and worth-it are not the same message. Shouting RM50 all-you-can-eat on its own reads as a compromise on quality; to make someone drive over, they need to see what is actually in the pot and what the room feels like. Two outlets in Serdang and PJ also means the content has to work for two different catchments.

approach.zh: 以促销价格为核心钩子（RM50 Buffet 挑战、午餐免费续面），影片长度做到 30–68 秒，留足空间展示菜色与用餐氛围，适合投放在餐饮决策前的浏览场景。
approach.en: Promotional pricing carries the hook (the RM50 buffet challenge, free lunch refills). Runtimes of 30–68 seconds leave room to show the spread and the room itself — suited to the browsing moment before a dining decision.

zh: 4 支餐饮短视频（30–68 秒）
促销主题：RM50 Buffet / 免费续面 / PJ 分店
en: Promo themes: RM50 buffet / free refills / PJ outlet

highlight.en: Shot from the B2B buyer's view

summary.zh: 为 TGIF Print Shop 制作 4 支 B2B 短视频，切入本地礼盒工厂、中秋节档期与包装升级三个主题，面向需要客制包装的商家客户。
summary.en: Four B2B short videos for TGIF Print Shop covering local gift-box manufacturing, the Mid-Autumn season and packaging upgrades — aimed at businesses sourcing custom packaging.

challenge.zh: 包装印刷是 B2B，决策者是商家而不是消费者。他们不会因为「设计漂亮」下单，关心的是交期、起订量、以及包装能不能撑起自家产品的价格。难点在于把「包装升级」这件抽象的事，讲成对方看得懂的生意问题。中秋这类档期又有明确的时间窗口。
challenge.en: Packaging is a B2B purchase — the decision sits with a business owner, not a shopper. Nobody orders because a design looks nice; they are weighing lead time, minimum order and whether the box can hold up the price they want to charge. The task is turning something as abstract as a packaging upgrade into a business problem they recognise. Seasons like Mid-Autumn also come with a hard window.

approach.zh: 影片以商家视角出发（「包装礼盒找本地工厂」「丢掉地摊货包装」），用对比手法呈现包装升级前后的品牌感差异；中秋档期单独出一支应节内容。
approach.en: Shot from the buyer’s perspective — “source your gift boxes locally”, “drop the street-stall packaging” — using before/after contrast to show what better packaging does for a brand, plus a dedicated Mid-Autumn seasonal cut.

zh: 4 支 B2B 短视频
主题：本地工厂 / 包装升级 / 中秋档期
en: Themes: local manufacturing / packaging upgrade / Mid-Autumn

highlight.zh: B2C 疗程 + B2B 招商 双线
highlight.en: Dual track: B2C treatment + B2B recruitment

summary.zh: 为 MJ Pro 制作 2 支短视频，分成 B2C 与 B2B 两条线：B2C 主打祛斑疗程效果，B2B 面向想做轻创业的美业招商受众。
summary.en: Two short videos for MJ Pro across two tracks: B2C content on pigmentation treatment results, and B2B content aimed at recruiting beauty-industry distributors.

challenge.zh: 同一个品牌要同时面对两种完全相反的受众：想解决斑点问题的消费者，和想找副业机会的潜在经销商。前者要看疗程效果与安全性，后者要看市场规模与获利可能。两种内容混在同一个账号，讯息会互相稀释。
challenge.en: One brand, two audiences pulling in opposite directions: consumers wanting a pigmentation problem solved, and prospective distributors weighing a side income. The first needs to see results and safety, the second needs market size and upside. Run together on one account, each message dilutes the other.

approach.zh: B2C 影片聚焦疗程本身与仪器操作画面；B2B 影片用发布会现场与人群反应带出「轻创业」的机会感，同一品牌两种受众分开投放。
approach.en: B2C videos focus on the treatment and the device in use; B2B videos use launch-event footage and crowd reaction to convey the business opportunity — one brand, two audiences, run separately.

zh: 2 支短视频
B2C 祛斑疗程 1 支 + B2B 招商 1 支
en: 1 B2C treatment video + 1 B2B recruitment video

summary.zh: 为 Meta Genesis 制作 6 张 Facebook 广告轮播设计，以「你还不知道你的旧 iPhone 值这么多？」作为主视觉钩子，引导受众滑看估价内容。
summary.en: A six-slide Facebook ad carousel for Meta Genesis, led by the hook “Did you know your old iPhone is worth this much?” to pull viewers through the valuation content.

challenge.zh: 二手手机回收的最大障碍是「不知道自己的旧机值多少」，多数人因此拖着不处理。同时这个品类信任度偏低，消费者担心被压价。内容要在还没接触之前就先建立价格透明的印象，而这需要一次讲完估价逻辑——单张图放不下。
challenge.en: The main obstacle in phone trade-in is that most people simply do not know what their old handset is worth, so they leave it in a drawer. The category also carries a trust problem — the fear of being lowballed. The content has to establish price transparency before any contact happens, and that means walking through the valuation logic, which does not fit in a single image.

approach.zh: 整组设计做成可左滑的轮播结构，首图用大字提问制造好奇，后续图逐步展开估价与流程信息，视觉上统一使用品牌蓝与科技感斜切排版。
approach.en: Built as a swipeable carousel: the first slide poses the question in oversized type, the following slides unpack valuation and process. Brand blue and angled tech-style layouts hold the set together.

zh: 6 张 Facebook 广告轮播设计
统一品牌视觉与轮播叙事结构
en: Unified brand visuals and carousel narrative

highlight.zh: 剧情式广告，降低广告感
highlight.en: Narrative ads that don't feel like ads

summary.zh: 为 Merslim 制作 2 支剧情式短视频广告，用「无法坦白的秘密」「神秘的跟踪狂」的悬念开场，把瘦身话题包装成故事再带出服务。
summary.en: Two narrative-style video ads for Merslim. Suspense-led openings — “the secret she couldn’t tell” and “the mysterious stalker” — wrap the slimming pitch inside a story before revealing the service.

challenge.zh: 瘦身是高度私人、也容易引起防备的话题。直接展示疗程或对比图，容易让人觉得被冒犯或不可信；而这个品类的广告又特别多，受众早已疲乏。难点在于如何在不说教、不制造焦虑的前提下，让人愿意把影片看完。
challenge.en: Weight is a private subject and a defensive one. Leading with treatments or before-and-afters risks reading as either offensive or unbelievable, and the category is so saturated that the audience is already numb to it. The problem is holding someone to the end of a video without lecturing them or manufacturing anxiety.

approach.zh: 不走直白的疗程介绍，改用短剧情制造悬念留住观看时长，结尾才落到服务本身，适合在信息流中降低广告感。
approach.en: Rather than a straight treatment explainer, short dramatised scenes hold watch time and the service only lands at the end — lowering the ad-feel in a scrolling feed.

zh: 2 支剧情式短视频广告（28 秒 / 44 秒）

highlight.zh: 全马来文口播，门店实拍

summary.zh: 为 Deluxe Tint 制作 2 支马来文短视频，在店内实景拍摄，以「车子热是因为还没贴膜」的日常痛点作为开场钩子。
summary.en: Two Malay-language short videos for Deluxe Tint, shot on location in the workshop and opening on an everyday pain point — “your car is hot because you haven’t tinted it yet”.

challenge.zh: 汽车贴膜对多数车主是「知道但一直没去做」的事。它不痛不痒，永远排在待办清单最后。而且这是马来受众为主的品类，内容要用他们日常讲话的方式切入，用中文或太正式的马来文都会有距离感。
challenge.en: For most drivers, window tinting is something they know about but never get around to. It is not painful enough to act on, so it stays at the bottom of the list. The category also skews to a Malay-speaking audience, and content has to sound like how they actually talk — Chinese, or an over-formal Malay, both keep the viewer at arm’s length.

approach.zh: 全程马来文口播，面向本地马来受众；在门店实景拍摄，画面同时展示施工环境与车漆质感，兼顾说服力与专业感。
approach.en: Fully Malay-language delivery for a local Malay audience, shot inside the workshop so the footage carries both the install environment and the finish quality.

zh: 2 支马来文短视频（门店实拍）
en: 2 Malay-language short videos shot on location
